text:
faye: quick heads-up — during a restore smoke for backups I hit KMS AccessDenied on a handful of old DB snapshots. triage please.

omar: which prefix and how many objects?

faye: s3://prod-backups/db-monthly/2026-02-01/ — 4 snaps failed decrypt. restore process aborts with `KMS AccessDeniedException`.

devsec: paste head-object for one failing file. sometimes the stored key-id/alias in metadata is wrong after rotations.

faye: here

```
$ aws s3api head-object --bucket prod-backups --key db-monthly/2026-02-01/snap-4.snap
{
  "ContentLength": 54321000,
  "Metadata": {
    "x-amz-meta-kms-key-id": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/oldkey-1234",
    "x-amz-meta-cipher": "aes-gcm-v1",
    "x-amz-meta-agent": "uploader-legacy"
  }
}
```

faye: restore log shows:
```
2026-03-22T11:05:02Z ERROR restore: decrypt failed: KMS AccessDeniedException: arn:aws:sts::111122223333:assumed-role/backup-uploader is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/oldkey-1234
```

omar: I see UpdateAlias entries in CloudTrail for alias/prod-backups on 2026-03-20 pointing alias to newkey-9876. also a terraform key-policy change PR#5012 tightened principals. likely old key lost backup-uploader in key policy.

devsec: immediate mitigation options:
1) CreateGrant for backup-uploader -> oldkey-1234 (short TTL) with EncryptionContext constraint (purpose=backup).
2) Revert PR#5012 to restore old key-policy while we plan migration.
3) Re-encrypt old objects with new key (rewrap/copy) and update metadata table.

faye: applying CreateGrant now (will post id). prefer grant to minimize policy churn.

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0311-kms-decrypt-drift (sev: medium). runbook: /docs/encops/kms-rotation-backup-compat.md

faye: Grant created g-9f8e7d6c (TTL 3h). re-run restore for snap-4.snap — decrypt succeeds, restore completes to staging.

omar: good. longer term we need:
- migration job to rewrap older snapshots to current key (or maintain alias backstop until migration finished)
- CI gate: any UpdateAlias or key-policy change must include a migration plan or legacy grant step
- metadata DB: record explicit key-id used at upload time for every object and expose audit report
- CloudWatch alarm on repeated kms:AccessDenied for backup principals

devsec: also recommend adding EncryptionContext checks in grants and using key constraints to limit scope. we should avoid permanent broad IAM changes.

postmortem: assigned owner for postmortem and timeline. please dump CloudTrail request IDs and affected object list when scan completes.

faye: running a 30-day scan for mismatched metadata -> key-policy gaps. ETA 2h, will publish to #postmortems after. :thumbsup:
